msg: HashiCorp Vault image under the Business Source License: the Vault LICENSE covers 'Vault Version 1.15.0 or later' (Licensor: IBM). OpenBao's in-place guide was tested only from Vault 1.14.1 and gives no storage-compatibility guarantee for newer Vault.
fix: Use quay.io/openbao/openbao:<2.x tag>; a Vault 1.15+ data store needs a fresh OpenBao cluster, not an in-place swap.

msg: Vault older than 1.14.1: OpenBao's in-place migration guide says to upgrade to v1.14.1 first.
fix: Pin hashicorp/vault:1.14.1, upgrade, then swap to quay.io/openbao/openbao.

msg: HashiCorp Helm repo or hashicorp/vault chart: it deploys the BSL-licensed Vault server.
fix: helm repo add openbao https://openbao.github.io/openbao-helm then helm install openbao openbao/openbao.

msg: Installs Vault from HashiCorp's package repository, which ships the current BSL-licensed releases.
Storage backend not in OpenBao: the OpenBao 2.7.0 server registers raft, postgresql, pebbledb and inmem only; file storage was removed in 2.7.0 (September 23, 2026).
fix: Move to storage "raft" (or postgresql) with bao operator migrate before the swap.

msg: Auto-unseal seal that is no longer built in: since OpenBao 2.7.0 (September 23, 2026) the pkcs11, alicloudkms, awskms, azurekeyvault, gcpckms and ocikms seals must be installed as external plugins.
fix: Install the matching seal plugin from github.com/openbao/openbao-plugins before starting 2.7.0.

msg: Auth method OpenBao does not ship built in: the OpenBao registry lists approle, cert, jwt, kubernetes, oidc and userpass; kerberos, ldap and radius left the binary in 2.7.0. The mount is skipped at startup and serves no paths.
fix: Install the plugin from openbao-plugins, or move logins to jwt/oidc, kubernetes or cert.

msg: Secrets engine OpenBao does not ship built in (the registry lists kubernetes, kv, pki, rabbitmq, ssh, totp and transit). OpenBao's guide: the mount is skipped at startup and reads return 'No value found'.
fix: Install the plugin from openbao-plugins or re-home these secrets before the swap.

msg: Database plugin not built into OpenBao: the built-in list is mysql (4 variants), cassandra, influxdb, postgresql, redis and valkey.
fix: Register an external plugin for this database, or issue these credentials another way.

msg: VAULT_* variable: the bao CLI and OpenBao's api/client.go read BAO_ADDR, BAO_TOKEN, BAO_NAMESPACE and the other BAO_* names.
fix: Rename to the BAO_ equivalent (VAULT_ADDR becomes BAO_ADDR).

msg: Calls the vault binary: OpenBao's command is bao (bao operator migrate, bao plugin prune, bao namespace ...).
fix: Replace vault with bao on this line.

msg: Checks for Vault's hvs./hvb./hvr. token prefix: OpenBao issues new tokens as s./b./r.<random>, so this check rejects every token issued after the swap.
fix: Accept both forms, e.g. ^(hv)?[sbr]\. , or stop parsing the token format.

msg: disable_mlock: OpenBao does not use mlock since 2.0.0 and its migration guide says to remove this line.
fix: Delete the disable_mlock line from the server config.

msg: Vault Enterprise licence setting: OpenBao's migration guide covers Vault Community Edition only, not Vault Enterprise.
fix: List the Enterprise features this cluster uses (namespaces, replication, HSM) and test each on OpenBao before cutover.
